description: Backbone vs side-chain clash test for pTyr in SDF-9, and grid-based active-site cavity volume versus PTP1B
code:
import requests, numpy as np, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_pdb(txt, chain=None):
    res={}; order=[]; het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; ri=L[22:27]; name=L[12:16].strip()
        if name.startswith('H') or L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        b=float(L[60:66]) if len(L)>=66 and L[60:66].strip() else 0.0
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=(ch,ri)
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{},'ri':int(ri[:4]),'b':b}; order.append(k)
            res[k]['atoms'][name]=xyz
            if name=='CA': res[k]['b']=b
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),name,xyz))
    return dict(order=order,res=res,seq=''.join(AA3.get(res[k]['rn'],'X') for k in order),
                ca=np.array([res[k]['atoms'].get('CA',np.full(3,np.nan)) for k in order]),
                het=het,num=[res[k]['ri'] for k in order])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0); V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt, pc, qc
def tm_dp(S,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi1=M[i-1];Mi=M[i];Si=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Mi1[j-1]+Si[j-1]; b=Mi1[j]+gap; c=Mi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a;P[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b;P[i,j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c;P[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=P[i,j]
        if k==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]

AF=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
PTY=requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
sdf=parse_pdb(AF); pty=parse_pdb(PTY,'A')
idxS={n:i for i,n in enumerate(sdf['num'])}; idxP={n:i for i,n in enumerate(pty['num'])}
anchors=[(59,66,65,72),(75,95,81,101),(159,176,169,186),(218,236,210,228)]
pairs=[(idxS[s0+d],idxP[p0+d]) for s0,s1,p0,p1 in anchors for d in range(s1-s0+1) if s0+d in idxS and p0+d in idxP]
caA,caB=sdf['ca'],pty['ca']; d0=max(1.24*(min(len(caA),len(caB))-15)**(1/3)-1.8,.5)
for it in range(12):
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(caA[[p[0] for p in pairs]],caB[[p[1] for p in pairs]]); A2=(caA-pc)@R+qc
    d2=((A2[:,None,:]-caB[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1); np_=tm_dp(1/(1+d2/d0**2))
    if np_==pairs: break
    pairs=np_
keep=pairs
for _ in range(5):
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(caA[[p[0] for p in keep]],caB[[p[1] for p in keep]]); A2=(caA-pc)@R+qc
    dv=np.linalg.norm(A2[[p[0] for p in keep]]-caB[[p[1] for p in keep]],axis=1)
    k2=[p for p,dd in zip(keep,dv) if dd<4.0]
    if len(k2)<40: break
    keep=k2
R,pc,qc=kabsch(caA[[p[0] for p in keep]],caB[[p[1] for p in keep]])
dv=np.linalg.norm(((caA-pc)@R+qc)[[p[0] for p in keep]]-caB[[p[1] for p in keep]],axis=1)
rmsd_core=np.sqrt((dv**2).mean())
Rinv=R.T
to_sdf=lambda x:(x-qc)@Rinv+pc

# --- the two PTR copies in 1PTY: identify active-site one (nearest to residue 215 CA) ---
ptr_ids=sorted(set(h[2] for h in pty['het'] if h[1]=='PTR'))
ca215=pty['res'][pty['order'][idxP[215]]]['atoms']['CA']
sites={}
for pid in ptr_ids:
    at=[(h[3],h[4]) for h in pty['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==pid]
    c=np.mean([a[1] for a in at],0)
    sites[pid]=(np.linalg.norm(c-ca215), at)
act_id=min(sites,key=lambda k:sites[k][0])
print(f"1PTY PTR copies {ptr_ids}; distances to res215 CA: "+", ".join(f"{k}:{sites[k][0]:.1f}A" for k in sites))
print(f"-> active-site pTyr = PTR {act_id}\n")
names=[a[0] for a in sites[act_id][1]]; XYZ=np.array([a[1] for a in sites[act_id][1]])
XYZs=to_sdf(XYZ)

BB={'N','CA','C','O','CB'}
def atomlist(st, bb_only=False):
    A=[];L=[]
    for k in st['order']:
        for an,x in st['res'][k]['atoms'].items():
            if bb_only and an not in BB: continue
            A.append(x); L.append((st['res'][k]['rn'],st['res'][k]['ri'],an))
    return np.array(A),L
Sall,Lall=atomlist(sdf); Sbb,Lbb=atomlist(sdf,True)
Pall,LPall=atomlist(pty); Pbb,LPbb=atomlist(pty,True)
def mind(X,A): 
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-A[None,:,:],axis=-1); return D.min(1), D.argmin(1)
m_all,j_all=mind(XYZs,Sall); m_bb,j_bb=mind(XYZs,Sbb)
p_all,_=mind(XYZ,Pall); p_bb,_=mind(XYZ,Pbb)
print(f"{'atom':5s} {'SDF9 all':>9} {'SDF9 bb/CB':>11} {'nearest SDF-9 (all)':>24} | {'PTP1B all':>9} {'PTP1B bb/CB':>11}")
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    tgt=f"{Lall[j_all[i]][0]}{Lall[j_all[i]][1]}:{Lall[j_all[i]][2]}"
    print(f"{n:5s} {m_all[i]:9.2f} {m_bb[i]:11.2f} {tgt:>24} | {p_all[i]:9.2f} {p_bb[i]:11.2f}")
print(f"\nSDF-9: clashes<2.6A all-atom {(m_all<2.6).sum()}/{len(names)}, backbone+CB {(m_bb<2.6).sum()}/{len(names)}")
print(f"PTP1B: clashes<2.6A all-atom {(p_all<2.6).sum()}/{len(names)}, backbone+CB {(p_bb<2.6).sum()}/{len(names)}")
print(f"core superposition RMSD {rmsd_core:.2f} A over {len(keep)} CA")

# --- grid pocket detection at the active site ---
def pocket(st, center, box=16.0, step=0.7, probe=1.4, rvdw=1.8, burial_cut=22):
    A,_=atomlist(st)
    g=np.arange(-box/2,box/2+1e-9,step)
    G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(g,g,g,indexing='ij'),-1).reshape(-1,3)+center
    sub=A[np.linalg.norm(A-center,axis=1)<box]
    D=np.linalg.norm(G[:,None,:]-sub[None,:,:],axis=-1)
    free=D.min(1)>(rvdw+probe)
    # buriedness: fraction of 42 ray directions that hit protein within 10 A
    dirs=[]
    gold=np.pi*(3-np.sqrt(5))
    for i in range(42):
        y=1-2*(i+0.5)/42; r=np.sqrt(max(0,1-y*y)); th=gold*i
        dirs.append([np.cos(th)*r,y,np.sin(th)*r])
    dirs=np.array(dirs)
    cand=G[free]
    bur=np.zeros(len(cand))
    ts=np.arange(1.5,11.0,0.7)
    for d in dirs:
        pts=cand[:,None,:]+d[None,None,:]*ts[None,:,None]
        DD=np.linalg.norm(pts.reshape(-1,1,3)-sub[None,:,:],axis=-1).min(1).reshape(len(cand),len(ts))
        bur+= (DD<rvdw).any(1)
    buried = cand[bur>=burial_cut]
    return buried, bur, step**3

# active-site centre: SDF-9 = centroid of P-loop 223-229 CA + 4A outward; PTP1B = phosphate position
sdf_center = np.mean([sdf['res'][sdf['order'][idxS[r]]]['atoms']['CA'] for r in range(223,230)],0)
pty_center = np.mean([pty['res'][pty['order'][idxP[r]]]['atoms']['CA'] for r in range(215,222)],0)
bs,burs,vox=pocket(sdf,sdf_center); bp,burp,_=pocket(pty,pty_center)
print(f"\nBuried cavity volume within 16 A box at active site (probe 1.4 A, buriedness>=22/42 rays):")
print(f"  PTP1B 1PTY (ligands removed): {len(bp)*vox:7.1f} A^3")
print(f"  SDF-9  AlphaFold model      : {len(bs)*vox:7.1f} A^3   ratio {len(bs)/max(len(bp),1):.2f}")

plddt=np.array([sdf['res'][k]['b'] for k in sdf['order']])
for lbl,rng in [('P-loop 222-231',range(222,232)),('"WPD" 167-175',range(167,176)),('pTyr-loop region 36-44',range(36,45))]:
    v=[plddt[idxS[r]] for r in rng if r in idxS]
    print(f"pLDDT {lbl}: mean {np.mean(v):.1f} (min {np.min(v):.1f})")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]; x=np.arange(len(names)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,p_all,w,label='pTyr in PTP1B native pocket (1PTY)',color='#4C72B0')
ax.bar(x+w/2,m_all,w,label='pTyr superposed into SDF-9 model',color='#C44E52')
ax.axhline(2.6,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(0.1,2.75,'2.6 A clash threshold',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('closest protein heavy atom (A)')
ax.set_title('Active-site phosphotyrosine does not fit SDF-9\n(core superposition RMSD %.2f A, %d CA pairs)'%(rmsd_core,len(keep)),fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(['PTP1B\n(1PTY, apo)','SDF-9\n(AlphaFold)'],[len(bp)*vox,len(bs)*vox],color=['#4C72B0','#C44E52'])
ax.set_ylabel('buried cavity volume at active site (A$^3$)')
ax.set_title('Active-site cavity volume',fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate([len(bp)*vox,len(bs)*vox]): ax.text(i,v+5,f'{v:.0f}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
